modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: Good morning, everyone, and happy Friday 😎 Here is another Kling 4.0 video. Will we be able to make a game very similar to what No Man’s Sky looked like in the early trailers before the team eventually does it themselves? 😁 You can find the prompt below, btw 😉 https://t.co/bOJHhRirxF

originalPrompt: Two enormous long-necked alien animals slowly walk through a shallow turquoise lagoon surrounded by bright red grass and exotic palm forests. Their massive bodies create realistic waves and splashes with every step while smaller creatures flee along the shoreline. The camera begins low near the water and smoothly cranes upward, revealing the gigantic animals against a glowing yellow-green sky and distant mountains. Realistic weight and inertia, detailed skin movement, volumetric mist, natural vegetation motion, cinematic alien wildlife documentary, smooth continuous camera movement, highly coherent anatomy.
